pv21:1.1: [FOOTNOTES] Yassa atthāya gacchāma Kambojaṃ dhanahārakā ayaṃ kāmadado yakkho imaṃ yakkhaṃ nīyāmase. || ||
pv21:2.1: Imaṃ yakkhaṃ gahetvāna sādhukena pasayha vā yānaṃ āropayitvāna khippaṃ gacchāma Dvāraka ti. || ||
pv21:3.1: Yassa rukkhassa chāyaya nisīdeyya sayeyya vā na tassa sākhaṃ bhindeyya mittadubbho hi pāpako ti. || ||
pv21:4.1: Yassa rukkhassa chāyāya nisīdeyya sayeyya vā khandham pi tassa chindeyya attho ce tādiso siyā ti. || ||
pv21:5.1: Yassa rukkhassa chāyāya nisīdeyya sayeyya vā na tassa pattaṃ bhindeyya mittadubbho hi pāpako ti. || ||
pv21:6.1: Yassa rukkhassa chāyāya nisīdeyya sayeyya vā samūlam pi taṃ abhuyha attho ce tādiso siyā ti. || ||
pv21:7.1: Yass' ekarattim pi ghare vaseyya Yatth' annapānaṃ puriso labhetha na tassa pāpaṃ manasā pi cetaye kataññutā sappurisehi vaṇṇitā. || ||
pv21:8.1: Yass' ekarattim pi ghare vaseyya annena pānena upaṭṭhito siyā na tassa pāpaṃ manasā pi cetaye adubbhapāṇī dahate mittadubbhiṃ. || ||
pv21:9.1: Yo pubbe katakalyāṇo pacchā pāpena hiṃsati allapāṇihato poso na so bhadrāni passatī ti. || ||
pv21:10.1: Nāhaṃ devena vā manussena vā issariyena vāhaṃ suppasayho yakkho 'ham asmi paramiddhipatto dūraṅgamo vaṇṇabalūpapanno ti. || ||
pv21:11.1: Pāṇi te sabbasovaṇṇo pañcadhāro madhussavo nānā rasā paggharanti maññe 'haṃ taṃ purindadaṃ. || || N' amhi
pv21:12.1: devo na gandhabbo nāpi Sakko purindado petaṃ maṃ Aṅkura jānāhi Bheruvamhā idhāgatan ti. || ||
pv21:13.1: Kiṃsīlo kiṃsamācāro Bheruvasmiṃ pure tuvaṃ kena te brahmacariyena puññaṃ pāṇimhi ijjhati. || ||
pv21:14.1: Tunnavāyo pure āsiṃ Bheruvasmiṃ tadā ahaṃ sukicchavutti kapaṇo na me vijjati dātave. || ||
pv21:15.1: Āvesanañ ca me āsi Asayhassa upantike saddhassa dānapatino katapuññassa lajjino. || ||
pv21:16.1: Tattha yācanakā yanti {nānāgottā} vanibbakā te ca maṃ tattha pucchanti Asayhassa nivesanaṃ: || ||
pv21:17.1: Kattha gacchāma bhaddaṃ vo kattha dānaṃ padīyati. Tesāhaṃ puṭṭho vakkhāmi Asayhassa nivesanaṃ, || ||
pv21:18.1: Paggayha dakkhiṇaṃ bāhuṃ: ettha gacchatha bhaddaṃ vo ettha dānaṃ padīyati Asayhassa nivesane. || ||
pv21:19.1: Tena pāṇi kāmadado tena pāṇi madhussavo tena me brahmacariyena puññaṃ pāṇimhi ijjhatī ti. || ||
pv21:20.1: Na kira tvaṃ adā dānaṃ sakapāṇīhi kassaci parassa dānaṃ anumodamāno pāṇiṃ paggayha pāvadi. || ||
pv21:21.1: Tena pāni kāmadado tena pāṇi madhussavo tena te brahmacariyena puññaṃ pāṇimhi ijjhati. || ||
pv21:22.1: Yo so dānam adā bhante pasanno sakapāṇihi so hitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ kin nu so disetaṃ gato. || || Nāhaṃ
pv21:23.1: pajānāmi asayhasāhino aṅgīrasassa gatim āgatiṃ vā sutañ ca me Vessavaṇassa santike sakkassa sahavyataṃ gato Asayho. || || Alam
pv21:24.1: eva kātuṃ kalyāṇaṃ dānaṃ dātuṃ yathārahaṃ pāṇiṃ kāmadadaṃ disvā ko puññaṃ na karissati. || ||
pv21:25.1: So hi nūna ito gantvā anuppatvāna Dvārakaṃ dānaṃ paṭṭhāpayissāmi yaṃ mam' assa sukhāvahaṃ. || ||
pv21:26.1: Dassām' annañ ca pānañ ca vatthasenāsanāni ca papañ ca udapānañ ca dugge saṅkamanāni cā ti. || ||
pv21:27.1: Kena te aṅgulī kuṇṭhā mukhañ ca kuṇḍalīkataṃ akkhīni ca paggharanti kiṃ pāpaṃ pakataṃ tayā ti. || ||
pv21:28.1: Aṅgīrarasassa gahapatino saddhassa gharam esino tassāhaṃ dānavissagge dāne adhikato ahuṃ. || ||
pv21:29.1: Tattha yācanake disvā āgate bhojanatthike ekam antaṃ apakkamma akāsiṃ kuṇḍalīmukhaṃ. || ||
pv21:30.1: Tena me aṅgulī kuṇṭhā mukhañ ca kuṇḍalīkataṃ akkhīni ca paggharanti taṃ pāpaṃ pakataṃmayā ti. || ||
pv21:31.1: Dhammena te kāpurisa mukhañ ca kuṇḍalīkataṃ akkhīni ca paggharanti yaṃ tvaṃ parassa dānassa akāsi kuṇḍalīmukhan ti. || ||
pv21:32.1: Kathaṃ hi dānaṃ dadamāno kareyya parapattiyaṃ annapānaṃ khādanīyaṃ vatthasenāsanāni ca ti. || ||
pv21:33.1: So hi nūna ito gantvā anuppatvāna Dvārakaṃ dānaṃ paṭṭhāpayissāmi yaṃ mam' assa sukhāvahaṃ. || ||
pv21:34.1: Dassām' annañ ca pānañ ca vatthasenāsanāni ca papañ ca udapānañ ca dugge saṅkamanāni ca. || || Tato
pv21:35.1: hi so nivattitvā anuppatvāna Dvārakaṃ dānaṃ paṭṭhayi Aṅkuro yaṃ tumassa sukhāvahaṃ. || ||
pv21:36.1: Adā annañ ca pānañ ca vatthasenāsanāni ca papañ ca udapānañ ca vippasannena cetasā: || ||
pv21:37.1: Ko chāto ko ca tasito ko vatthaṃ parivassati kassa santāni yoggāni ito yojentu vāhanaṃ. || ||
pv21:38.1: Ko chatt' icchati gandhañ ca ko mālaṃ ko upāhanaṃ iti ssu tattha ghosenti kappakā sūda-māgadhā sadā sayañ ca pāto ca Aṅkurassa nivesane ti. || ||
pv21:39.1: Sukhaṃ supati Aṅkuro iti jānāti maṃ jano dukkhaṃ supāmi Sindhaka yaṃ na passāmi yācake. || ||
pv21:40.1: Sukhaṃ supati Aṅkuro iti jānāti maṃ jano dukkhaṃ supāmi Sindhaka appake su vanibbake ti. || ||
pv21:41.1: Sakko ce te varaṃ dajjā Tāvatiṃsānam issaro Kissa sabbassa lokassa varamāno varaṃ vare ti. || ||
pv21:42.1: Sakko ce me varaṃ dajjā Tāvatiṃsānam issaro kāluṭṭhitassa me sato suriyass' uggamanaṃ pati dibbā bhakkhā pātubhaveyyuṃ sīlavanto ca yācakā. || ||
pv21:43.1: Dadato me na khīyetha datvā nānutappeyy' ahaṃ dadaṃ cittaṃ pasādeyyaṃ evaṃ Sakkaṃ varaṃ vare ti. || ||
pv21:44.1: Na sabbavittāni pare pavecche dadeyya dānañ ca dhanañ ca rakkhe tasmā hi dānā dhanam eva seyyo atippadānena kulā na honti. || ||
pv21:45.1: Adānaṃ atidānañ ca nappasaṃsanti paṇḍitā tasmā hi dānā dhanam eva seyyo samena vatteyya sa dhīradhammo ti. || ||
pv21:46.1: Aho vatā re aham eva dajjaṃ santo hi maṃ sappurisā bhajeyyuṃ megho va ninnān' abhipūrayanto santappaye sabbavanibbakānaṃ. || ||
pv21:47.1: Yassa yācanake disvā mukhavaṇṇo pasīdati datvā attamano hoti taṃ gharaṃ vasato sukhaṃ. || ||
pv21:48.1: Yassa yācanake disvā mukhavaṇṇo pasīdati datvā attamano hoti esā puññassa sampadā. || ||
pv21:49.1: Pubbe va dānā sumano dadaṃ cittaṃ pasādaye datvā attamano hoti eso puññassa sampadā ti. || ||
pv21:50.1: Saṭṭhivāhasahassāni Aṅkurassa nivesane bhojanaṃ dīyate niccaṃ puññapekkhassa jantuno. || ||
pv21:51.1: Tisahassāni sūdā hi āmuttamaṇikuṇḍalā Aṅkuraṃ upajūvanti dāne yaññassa vyāvaṭā. || ||
pv21:52.1: Saṭṭhipurisasahassāni āmuttamaṇikuṇḍalā Aṅkurassa mahādāne kaṭṭhaṃ phālenti māṇavā. || ||
pv21:53.1: Soḷasitthisahassāni sabbālaṅkārabhūsitā Aṅkurassa mahādāne vidhā piṇḍenti nāriyo. || ||
pv21:54.1: Soḷasitthisahassāni sabbālaṅkārabhūsitā Aṅkurassa mahādāne dabbigāhā upaṭṭhitā. || ||
pv21:55.1: Bahuṃ bahunnaṃ pādāsi ciraṃ pādāsi khattiyo sakkaccañ ca sahatthā ca cittīkatvā punappunaṃ. || ||
pv21:56.1: Bahū māse ca pakkhe ca utu-saṃvaccharāni ca mahādānaṃ pavattesi Aṅkuro dīgham antaraṃ. || ||
pv21:57.1: Evaṃ datvā yajitvā ca Aṅkuro dīgham antaraṃ so hitvā mānusaṃ deham Tāvatiṃsūpago ahū ti. || ||
pv21:58.1: Kaṭacchubhikkhaṃ datvāna Anuruddhassa Indako so hitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsūpago ahū. || ||
pv21:59.1: Dasahi ṭhānehi Aṅkuraṃ Indako atirocati rūpe sadde rase gandhe phoṭṭhabbe ca manorame, || ||
pv21:60.1: Āyunā yasasā c' eva vaṇṇena ca sukhena ca ādhipaccena Aṅkuraṃ Indako atirocatī ti. || ||
pv21:62.1: Tāvatiṃse yadā buddho sīlāyaṃ paṇḍukambale pāricchattakamūlamhi vihāsi purisuttamo, || ||
pv21:63.1: Dasasu lokadhātūsu sannipatitvāna devatā payirupāsanti sambuddhaṃ vasantaṃ nagamuddhani. || ||
pv21:64.1: Na koci devo vaṇṇena sambuddhaṃ atirocati sabbe deve adhigayha sambuddho va virocati. || ||
pv21:65.1: Yojanāni dasa dve ca Aṅkuro 'yaṃ tadā ahu avidūre sambuddhassa Indako atirocati. || ||
pv21:66.1: Oloketvāna sambuddho Aṅkurañ cāpi Indakaṃ dakkhiṇeyyaṃ pabhāvento idaṃ vacanam abravi: || ||
pv21:67.1: Mahādānaṃ tayā dinnaṃ Aṅkura dīgham antaraṃ atidūre nisinno 'si āgaccha mama santike. || || Codito
pv21:68.1: bhāvitattena Aṅkuro idam abravi: kiṃ mayhaṃ tena dānena dakkhiṇeyyena suññataṃ. || ||
pv21:69.1: Ayaṃ so Indako yakkho dajjā dānaṃ parittakaṃ atirocati amhe hi cando tāragaṇe yathā. || || Ujjaṅgale
pv21:70.1: yathā khette bījaṃ bahukam pi ropitaṃ na vipulaṃ phalaṃ hoti na pi toseti kassakaṃ. || ||
pv21:71.1: Tath' eva dānaṃ bahukaṃ dussīlesu patiṭṭhitaṃ na vipulaṃ phalaṃ hoti na pi toseti dāyakaṃ. || ||
pv21:72.1: Yathā pi bhaddake khette bījaṃ appam pi ropitaṃ sammādhāraṃ pavecchante phalaṃ toseti kassakaṃ, || ||
pv21:73.1: Tath' eva sīlavantesu guṇavantesu tādisu appakam pi kataṃ kāraṃ puññaṃ hoti mahaphalan ti. || ||
pv21:74.1: Viceyya dānam dātabbaṃ yattha dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ viceyya dānaṃ datvāna saggaṃ gacchanti dāyakā. || ||
pv21:75.1: Viceyya dānaṃ sugatappasatthaṃ ye dakkhiṇeyyā idha jīvaloke etesu dinnāni mahapphalāni bījāni vuttāni yathā sukhette ti. || ||
